sentences.en: Friar Lawrence’s Cell
sentences.ko: 로런스 신부의 수도실

summary.en: Friar Lawrence learns that his letter to Romeo never arrived. He hurries to the tomb.
summary.ko: 로런스 신부는 로미오에게 보낸 편지가 전해지지 않았다는 것을 알게 된다. 그는 서둘러 무덤으로 간다.

sentences.en: Holy Franciscan Friar!
sentences.ko: 거룩한 프란치스코회 형제여!

sentences.en: Brother, hello!
sentences.ko: 형제여, 계십니까!

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
This same should be the voice of Friar John.
Welcome from Mantua. What says Romeo?
Or, if his mind be writ, give me his letter.

sentences.en: This should be the voice of Friar John.
sentences.ko: 존 신부 목소리로군.

sentences.en: Welcome from Mantua.
sentences.ko: 만토바에서 잘 돌아왔네.

sentences.en: What does Romeo say?
sentences.ko: 로미오는 뭐라던가?

sentences.en: Or, if he has written his thoughts, give me his letter.
sentences.ko: 생각을 편지로 적었다면 그 편지를 주게.

speaker: FRIAR JOHN
raw:
Going to find a barefoot brother out,
One of our order, to associate me,
Here in this city visiting the sick,
And finding him, the searchers of the town,
Suspecting that we both were in a house
Where the infectious pestilence did reign,
Seal’d up the doors, and would not let us forth,
So that my speed to Mantua there was stay’d.

sentences.en: I went to find another barefoot friar of our order to go with me.
sentences.ko: 저와 함께 갈 우리 수도회의 다른 맨발 신부를 찾으러 갔어요.

sentences.en: He was here in this city visiting the sick.
sentences.ko: 그분은 병자들을 돌보러 이 도시에 와 계셨죠.

sentences.en: When I found him, the town health officers stopped us.
sentences.ko: 그분을 찾았을 때, 마을 보건 관리인들이 우리를 막아 세웠어요.

sentences.en: They thought we had both been in a house where the plague was spreading.
sentences.ko: 그들은 우리가 역병이 퍼진 집에 함께 있었던 것으로 생각했거든요.

sentences.en: They sealed the doors and would not let us out.
sentences.ko: 그들은 문을 봉쇄하고 우리를 내보내 주지 않았어요.

sentences.en: So my trip to Mantua was stopped.
sentences.ko: 그래서 만토바로 가는 제 여정이 중단되었어요.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw: Who bare my letter then to Romeo?

sentences.en: Then who carried my letter to Romeo?
sentences.ko: 그럼 누가 내 편지를 로미오에게 가져갔나?

speaker: FRIAR JOHN
raw:
I could not send it,—here it is again,—
Nor get a messenger to bring it thee,
So fearful were they of infection.

sentences.en: I could not send it.
sentences.ko: 보낼 수가 없었어요.

sentences.en: Here it is now.
sentences.ko: 여기 그대로 있어요.

sentences.en: I could not find a messenger to bring it to you.
sentences.ko: 신부님께 도로 가져다줄 사람도 찾을 수 없었어요.

sentences.en: They were very afraid of the infection.
sentences.ko: 다들 전염병을 너무 무서워했거든요.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
Unhappy fortune! By my brotherhood,
The letter was not nice, but full of charge,
Of dear import, and the neglecting it
May do much danger. Friar John, go hence,
Get me an iron crow and bring it straight
Unto my cell.

sentences.en: Unfortunate luck!
sentences.ko: 운도 없지!

sentences.en: By my brotherhood, the letter was not simple but full of important instructions.
sentences.ko: 우리 형제의 의리를 걸고 말하지만, 그 편지는 예사 편지가 아니라 중요한 지시가 가득했네.

sentences.en: Ignoring it may cause much danger.
sentences.ko: 그걸 전하지 못하면 큰 위험이 생길 수 있네.

sentences.en: Friar John, go now and get me an iron crowbar.
sentences.ko: 존 신부, 지금 가서 쇠지렛대를 하나 구해 주게.

sentences.en: Bring it straight to my cell.
sentences.ko: 곧장 내 수도실로 가져오게.

speaker: FRIAR JOHN
raw: Brother, I’ll go and bring it thee.

sentences.en: Brother, I will go and bring it to you.
sentences.ko: 형제님, 가서 가져올게요.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
Now must I to the monument alone.
Within this three hours will fair Juliet wake.
She will beshrew me much that Romeo
Hath had no notice of these accidents;
But I will write again to Mantua,
And keep her at my cell till Romeo come.
Poor living corse, clos’d in a dead man’s tomb.

sentences.en: Now I must go to the tomb alone.
sentences.ko: 이제 혼자 무덤으로 가야 한다.

sentences.en: Juliet will wake in three hours.
sentences.ko: 줄리엣은 세 시간 안에 깨어날 것이다.

sentences.en: She will scold me because Romeo did not know about these events.
sentences.ko: 로미오가 이 일을 모른다는 걸 알면 그 애는 나를 원망하겠지.

sentences.en: But I will write to Mantua again.
sentences.ko: 하지만 만토바에 다시 편지를 쓰겠다.

sentences.en: I will keep her in my cell until Romeo comes.
sentences.ko: 로미오가 올 때까지 그 애를 내 수도실에 숨겨 두겠다.

sentences.en: Poor living body, trapped in a dead man's tomb.
sentences.ko: 죽은 자의 무덤에 갇힌 가여운 산 몸이여.
